---

Use this playbook for every [analytical output](guidance/09-resources/r1-glossary.qmd): published, used for an internal decision or given to a sponsor. [Check that it applies](guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/check-it-applies.qmd).

## Quick start

Work through the five phases of the [analytical lifecycle](guidance/analytical-cycle/index.qmd) in order. They are written for the analyst. If you asked for the analysis, go to [the commissioner guidance](guidance/06-roles/commissioner.qmd).

```{=html}
<ol class="pb-phases">
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/01-engagement-and-scoping/index.html">Phase 1. Engagement and scoping</a></h3>
    <p>Agree the question with your commissioner, and <a href="guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/score-the-impact.html">score the impact</a>.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/02-design/index.html">Phase 2. Design</a></h3>
    <p>Choose the method, <a href="guidance/07-deciding-your-assurance-level/score-the-likelihood.html">score the likelihood</a> to get your level, and plan the assurance it requires.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/03-analysis/index.html">Phase 3. Analysis</a></h3>
    <p>Do the analysis, check it, and have your critical friend review it.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/04-delivery-and-sign-off/index.html">Phase 4. Delivery, communication and sign-off</a></h3>
    <p>Deliver it with its caveats and quality assurance statement, and get it signed off.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/05-review/index.html">Phase 5. Review</a></h3>
    <p>Ask whether it informed the decision, and whether it is still right.</p>
  </li>
</ol>
```

If an impact dimension scored 4, go to [Business Critical analysis](guidance/08-business-critical/index.qmd).

## Guidance by role

```{=html}
<ul class="pb-cards">
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/06-roles/analyst.html">Analyst</a></h3>
    <p>Plan the work, do it, check it and write it up.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/06-roles/commissioner.html">Commissioner</a></h3>
    <p>State the decision and the deadline, and score the impact with the analyst.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/06-roles/critical-friend.html">Critical friend</a></h3>
    <p>Review one assignment, independently of the analyst. How independent depends on the assurance level.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/06-roles/analysis-senior-responsible-officer.html">Analysis Senior Responsible Officer</a></h3>
    <p>For Business Critical work, get named at scoping, review the assurance evidence and approve the output.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <h3><a href="guidance/09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.html">Who to ask</a></h3>
    <p>Level disputes, critical friends, official statistics, information governance and analytical code.</p>
  </li>
</ul>
```
